name: Scroll description with scroll-wheel
description: The story description currently can only be scrolled with page up + page down buttons. Make it so I can also scroll it with my mouse scroll wheel just like a regular UI application.

comments.author: sunny
comments.body: Complexity 2 (small, well-bounded TUI input change; done in one thread with no subagents). Branch claude/row-19-scroll-wheel. Plan: have the mouse parser report wheel notches, add an onWheel handler to the mouse registry, make ScrollBody (Story body) and MarkdownView scroll 3 lines per notch while they are active and overflowing, and mention the wheel in docs/user-guide.md.

comments.author: sunny
comments.body: Draft PR https://github.com/sgolovine/rowbly/pull/101 (branch claude/row-19-scroll-wheel, head 7989220). The mouse wheel now scrolls the Story body, Settings sections, dialog bodies and the full-screen editor's View mode, 3 lines per notch. Validation: typecheck pass, lint pass, test:unit 66/66, test:cli 20/20; checked by hand with agentic-tui (main: no movement; branch: 3 notches down → 10–23 of 50, 1 up → 7–20 of 50). Before/after screenshots are in a PR comment.
